choices.label: Option A
choices.feedback: This stores “lambda x: x[2])” in “intervals.sort(key”. On this test, it raises IndexError: list index out of range; the expected result is false.

choices.label: Option B
choices.feedback: Sort “intervals” with key=lambda x: x[0].

questions.prompt: Which values should “i” visit, and in what order?

choices.label: Option A
choices.feedback: Start “i” at 1, change it by 1 each time, and stop before the length of “intervals”.

choices.label: Option B
choices.feedback: This uses “for i in range(1, ((len(intervals)) + 1)):” instead of “for i in range(1, len(intervals)):”. On this test, it raises IndexError: list index out of range; the expected result is true.

choices.label: Option C
choices.feedback: This uses “for i in range(0, len(intervals)):” instead of “for i in range(1, len(intervals)):”. On this test, it returns false; the expected result is true.

choices.label: Option D
choices.feedback: This uses “for i in list(range(1, len(intervals)))[1:]:” instead of “for i in range(1, len(intervals)):”. On this test, it returns true; the expected result is false.
